fields.name: invoice_date
fields.description: the invoice creation or issue date.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: unique identifier, reference number, or invoice number.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: Full name of the person or company being billed.

fields.name: customer_billing_address
fields.description: Complete billing address. This is where bills and invoices are sent.

fields.name: customer_email
fields.description: Any email address associated with the customer.

fields.name: customer_phone
fields.description: Any phone number associated with the customer.

fields.name: shipping_name
fields.description: Name of the recipient for delivery (may differ from billing name).

fields.name: shipping_address
fields.description: Complete address where goods are delivered.

fields.name: shipping_phone
fields.description: Contact phone number for delivery purposes.

fields.name: vendor_name
fields.description: Name of the company or person issuing the invoice.

fields.name: vendor_address
fields.description: Complete business address of the vendor.

fields.name: vendor_email
fields.description: Vendor's contact email.

fields.name: vendor_phone
fields.description: Vendor's contact phone number.

fields.name: bank_name
fields.description: he name of the vendor's bank.

fields.name: bank_account_number
fields.description: The vendor's bank account number.

fields.name: branch_name
fields.description: The name of the bank branch used by the vendor.

fields.name: iban
fields.description: The International Bank Account Number (IBAN) of the vendor.

fields.name: swift
fields.description: The SWIFT code for the vendor's bank.

fields.name: tax_id
fields.description: The tax identification number of the vendor.

fields.name: sub_total
fields.description: Amount before tax or additional charges.

fields.name: tax
fields.description: The tax amount applied.

fields.name: total
fields.description: The final total amount including all charges.

fields.name: total_discount
fields.description: Total discount amount applied to the invoice.

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.description: Any specified payment conditions or terms.

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: The date by which payment must be made.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The currency used in the invoice.

fields.name: currency_sign
fields.description: The currency sign of the currency used in the invoice.

fields.name: shipping_charge
fields.description: Shipping or delivery fee as printed on the invoice (if applicable)

fields.name: carrier
fields.description: The shipping company who deliver the goods.

fields.name: purchase_order_number
fields.description: Reference number provided by the buyer to authorize the purchase.

fields.name: tax_rate
fields.description: Percentage of tax applied to the subtotal.

fields.name: tax_type
fields.description: Type of tax applied to the subtotal.
